description: Palak Paneer is a beloved Indian vegetarian dish featuring tender spinach puree and soft cubes of paneer cottage cheese. This creamy, vibrant curry is delicately spiced, offering a comforting and wholesome meal. It perfectly balances earthy greens with rich dairy, making it a staple in Indian cuisine.

instructions.title: Blanch the Spinach
instructions.text: Bring a large pot of water to a rolling boil. Add the washed spinach and blanch for 1-2 minutes until wilted. Immediately transfer the spinach to a bowl of ice-cold water to stop the cooking and preserve its vibrant green color. Drain well.

instructions.title: Prepare Spinach Puree
instructions.text: Once the blanched spinach is cool, squeeze out any excess water. Transfer the spinach to a blender or food processor along with the green chili and blend into a smooth puree. Add a little water if needed to achieve a fine consistency. Set aside.

instructions.title: Fry Paneer (Optional)
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil in a pan over medium heat. Add the cubed paneer and fry until light golden brown on all sides. Remove the paneer and immediately transfer it to a bowl of warm water for 10 minutes to keep it soft. Drain before adding to the curry. If you prefer, you can use unfried paneer directly.

instructions.title: Sauté Aromatics and Spices
instructions.text: In the same pan, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of ghee or oil. Once hot, add cumin seeds and let them splutter. Add the finely chopped onions and sauté until they turn golden brown, about 5-7 minutes. Stir in the ginger-garlic paste and cook for another minute until the raw aroma disappears.

instructions.title: Build the Masala Base
instructions.text: Add the pureed tomatoes to the pan and cook until the mixture thickens and the oil starts to separate from the sides, about 5-7 minutes. Now, add turmeric powder, coriander powder, red chili powder (if using), and salt. Mix well and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the spices are fragrant.

instructions.title: Combine and Simmer
instructions.text: Pour the spinach puree into the masala base. Mix thoroughly and bring to a gentle simmer. Add the fried or unfried paneer cubes. Cover and cook for 5-7 minutes on low heat, allowing the flavors to meld. Stir in the garam masala and crushed Kasuri Methi (if using). If desired, stir in 1-2 tablespoons of fresh cream or milk for a richer taste and smoother texture. Serve hot.

tips: Blanch the spinach briefly (1-2 minutes) and then immediately plunge it into ice-cold water to retain its vibrant green color and nutrients.
For extra soft paneer, soak the cubed paneer in warm water for 10-15 minutes after frying or if using it fresh, before adding it to the curry.
A pinch of sugar or a spoonful of fresh cream can balance the flavors and reduce any potential bitterness from the spinach, adding a lovely richness to the gravy.
